requested_architecture: Encoder-decoder LSTM, whole 15-day horizon with separate days 7-15 reporting

selected.origin: Previously trained in this workspace on eight real observed CAMELS-US catchments
selected.architecture: Separate hidden-size-32 encoder and decoder LSTMs, state handoff, 5 ordered quantiles
selected.adaptation: Extend lead embeddings from 10 to 15; insert past discharge/missingness encoder columns at zero weights; fine-tune all parameters
selected.reason: Known donor-only year history and matching weather feature meanings, recurrent dimensions and output head. No download needed. This is not an official global pretrained checkpoint.

public_sources_reviewed.name: NeuralHydrology forecast model documentation
public_sources_reviewed.finding: Forecast encoder/decoder and state-handoff architectures are supported. This page is architecture documentation, not a compatible pretrained weight release.

public_sources_reviewed.name: NeuralHydrology fine-tuning tutorial
public_sources_reviewed.finding: Documents how to fine-tune a previously trained run; does not identify an exact matching public 15-day seq2seq checkpoint.

public_sources_reviewed.name: Fine Flood Forecasts public global pretrained model
public_sources_reviewed.finding: A genuine public global pretrained LSTM is available, but the paper describes a 365-day input and a single next-day output. It is not a drop-in 15-day encoder-decoder checkpoint. A separate global-LSTM module in this workspace is left untouched.

search_scope: Targeted primary documentation/paper search plus inspection of existing local model checkpoints; not an exhaustive claim that no other pretrained seq2seq exists.
